Code.

I am an Animation and Video Game Engineer from Universidad Panamericana, currently pursuing a postgraduate specialization in Interactive Design and a diploma in Data Science. My work sits at the intersection of frontend engineering, mobile development, product design, and data-informed thinking.

I build scalable web and mobile experiences that balance usability, visual clarity, and technical execution. My background in React, Next.js, React Native, SwiftUI, backend integrations, and game development gives me a broad perspective on how products are imagined, implemented, and improved.

I am especially interested in frontend systems, mobile applications, interaction design, backend integrations, cloud computing, and big data. My goal is to contribute to products that create value by connecting design, code, and data into intuitive, maintainable, and high-performance digital experiences.
